ph_v1.opt0: Solid, heavy frame; I gain weight very easily and find it hard to lose.
ph_v1.opt1: Medium build; weight is stable and easy to manage.
ph_v1.opt2: Light build; I occasionally lose weight when stressed but can regain it.
ph_v1.opt3: Thin, light frame; I struggle to gain weight and lose it quickly.
ph_v1.opt4: Extremely thin, delicate/tall frame with prominent joints; gaining weight is nearly impossible.

ph_v2.opt0: Smooth, oily, or thick skin and lustrous hair.

ph_v2.opt2: Mildly dry skin or frizzy hair, especially in dry weather.
ph_v2.opt3: Noticeably dry, rough skin and brittle, split-end prone hair.
ph_v2.opt4: Chronically dry, cracked skin and extremely thin, dry, coarse hair.

ph_v3.opt0: Warm hands/feet; strong, highly predictable appetite and digestion.
ph_v3.opt1: Rarely feel unusually cold; digest most meals easily.
ph_v3.opt2: Sometimes get cold extremities; appetite fluctuates occasionally with gas/bloating.
ph_v3.opt3: Frequent cold hands/feet; unpredictable hunger and regular bloating or gas.
ph_v3.opt4: Constant cold intolerance; highly erratic digestion (extreme bloating, gas, or constipation).

ph_v4.opt0: Deep, heavy sleep for 8+ hours; hard to wake up.

ph_v4.opt4: Highly fitful, restless sleep (insomnia) with frequent waking; sleep less than 5-6 hours.

ph_p1.opt0: Thin/frail frame OR very broad/heavy frame.

ph_p1.opt2: Average build; can tone muscle with regular effort.
ph_p1.opt3: Good muscle tone and athletic, medium-framed build.
ph_p1.opt4: Well-defined, athletic, and symmetrical medium build; gain muscle easily.

ph_p2.opt0: Cool, dry skin; thick, dark, coarse hair.

ph_p4.opt4: Light-to-moderate sleep; frequently disrupted by night sweats, feeling hot, or midnight hunger.

VATA.title: Vata
VATA.explanation: Vata governs movement, breathing, circulation, and the nervous system. It is the driving force behind all bodily activity.
characteristics: Thin or light body frame, tends to lose weight easily
Cold hands and feet, prefers warmth
Quick thinker, learns fast but forgets fast
Enthusiastic and creative, but prone to anxiety when imbalanced
lifestyleRecommendations: Keep a regular daily routine, especially meal and sleep timings
Favor warm, cooked, moist, and lightly oiled foods
Stay warm; avoid excess cold, wind, and dry environments
Practice calming routines -- gentle yoga, meditation, warm oil self-massage
Avoid excessive fasting, overstimulation, and irregular schedules

PITTA.title: Pitta
PITTA.explanation: Pitta governs digestion, metabolism, and transformation -- including how the body processes food and how the mind processes information.
characteristics: Sharp intellect, good focus, natural leader
Ambitious and competitive, can become irritable under stress
possibleImbalances: Acidity, heartburn, or excess body heat
Excessive hunger or overeating when stressed
lifestyleRecommendations: Favor cooling, mildly spiced, and hydrating foods
Avoid excessive heat, sun exposure, and skipping meals
Build in downtime -- avoid overworking or overscheduling
Practice moderation; avoid excess alcohol, caffeine, and fried food
Cooling activities like swimming or evening walks help balance excess heat

KAPHA.title: Kapha
KAPHA.explanation: Kapha governs structure, stability, and lubrication in the body. It provides strength, immunity, and emotional calm.
characteristics: Solid, well-built body frame, gains weight easily
Deep sleeper, good stamina, resistant to sudden change
lifestyleRecommendations: Favor light, warm, and spiced foods; minimize heavy, oily, sugary foods
Stay physically active -- regular vigorous exercise is important
Avoid daytime sleeping and excessive rest
Seek variety and stimulation to counter inertia
Wake early and keep an energizing morning routine
